_schema: mchatai-source/verbs/ios/_capabilities.json — the Swift atoms the iOS app implements (Shared/OnDeviceAgent/AgentCapabilityRegistry.swift), one record each. A verb binds ONE capability (`capability`) or composes several (`steps`); content can never name one that is not here, and the app's drift test (AgentVerbCatalogTests) fails when this list and the Swift registry disagree. `safetyClass`: read < write < dangerous; a verb must declare at least the highest class of what it uses. `result` lists the fields a later step may bind as ${<step>.result.<field>}.

capabilities.summary: Finds a site's feed from its address (its advertised feed link, then /feed and /rss) and adds it to the sources the current agent searches; a site with no feed is added as a page to read.

Makes a new agent on this device from the person's words: picks its steps from the catalog by what they asked for, finds the feeds of any sites they named, fills the role from `template`, and saves it as one of their own agents.

template._note: How a new agent is filled in. Swift replaces {name} and {purpose}; `always` steps come first, then the steps the purpose's words route to, at most six; `starters` are keyed by step id and kept for the steps the agent got; `sources` are what it searches until the person names sites. `namePrompt` names an agent made from the agent pill's field, where no planner supplied a name; the app keeps the answer only when it is a few plain words.
template.prompt: You are {name}, an agent the person made on their iPhone or iPad. What you are for, in their words: {purpose}. Use your steps to do it, and do only what the person asks in each message. When a search finds several items and the person has not said which to use, stop and let them choose from the list. Never invent facts the steps did not return. Answer in at most three sentences.

starters.summarizeText: Summarize the top three for me.
starters.createDocument: Write up the best one in AI Write.
starters.createPodcast: Make a short podcast episode from the top stories.

template.namePrompt: Give a short name, two or three words, for an agent that will {purpose}. Reply with the name only.

capabilities.summary: Stops the current agent searching a source: a site the person added is detached from it, a catalog source is hidden for this agent only.
Creates a document in AI Write on this device and returns its id and link.
Returns an AI Write document's title and text by its id or title; on a miss, lists the closest titles instead of failing (invariant R2).
Transcribes an audio file on this device with Apple's on-device speech model in the language given.
Downloads a PDF and returns its text page by page, reading scanned pages with on-device OCR.
Reads a script aloud with the system voice and saves it as an episode in the Podcasts library on this device.
Fetches one item's full record (title, authors, date, abstract, link) from the source it came from, or reads its page when the source has no item lookup.
Searches one research source (a source pack or one of the person's own) and returns up to eight items.
Summarizes text with the on-device model in the style asked for (notes, a paragraph, a spoken script) within a word budget.

styles.notes: Write short notes on the text: the main points as a Markdown bullet list, in plain words, using only what the text says.
styles.paragraph: Write one clear paragraph that says what the text is and what it concludes, using only what the text says.
styles.script: Write a spoken script about the text in plain sentences, to be read aloud: no headings, no Markdown, no lists, using only what the text says.

capabilities.summary: Loads a web address and returns the page's title and visible text (a PDF address is read as a PDF).
